name: Charles Schwab Investor Credit Card™ from American Express

localized_names.en: Charles Schwab Investor Credit Card™ from American Express

apr.notes: Schwab's official Investor product page lists 0% introductory purchase APR for 6 months, then 19.74% to 28.74% variable based on creditworthiness and other factors. Purchase APR checked 2026-10-20. Cash advance APR and plan-fee fields remain the unverified July 2026 snapshot; this partial correction does not reverify those terms.

fx_fee.notes: 2.7% of each transaction after conversion to US dollars.

credit_required.notes: APR based on creditworthiness and other factors. Must maintain an eligible Schwab account (Schwab One, Schwab General Brokerage Account, or Schwab Traditional/Roth/Rollover IRA not managed by an independent advisor).

base_rate.description: 1.5% cash back on all eligible purchases, auto-deposited to linked Schwab brokerage account

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back is 1.5% of dollar amount of eligible purchases. Deposited directly into linked eligible Schwab brokerage account approximately 8-12 weeks after end of billing period. No cash back earned if Minimum Payment Due is not paid by Payment Due Date. Eligible account means (1) a Schwab One or Schwab General Brokerage Account or (2) a Schwab Traditional, Roth or Rollover IRA not managed by an independent investment advisor.

signup_bonus.description: $200 Statement Credit after making eligible purchases totaling $1,000 or more within first 3 months of Card Membership. Statement credit applied 8-12 weeks after Threshold Amount is met.

benefits.title: $0 Annual Fee
benefits.description: No annual fee for the Charles Schwab Investor Credit Card from American Express.

benefits.title: 0% Introductory APR for 6 Months
benefits.description: 0% introductory APR on purchases for first 6 months from account opening, then 19.74% to 28.74% variable based on creditworthiness and other factors. Plan-fee terms are not reverified by this purchase APR source.

benefits.title: American Express Venue Collection Concessions Statement Credit
benefits.description: Earn 10% back (up to $250) in statement credits per calendar year after using enrolled Card for qualifying food and beverage concessions purchases at stadiums and arenas in the American Express Venue Collection. Offer ends 12/31/2026.

notes: Charles Schwab Investor Credit Card from American Express, issued by American Express National Bank. Schwab's co-brand product page identifies the Investor card separately from the Schwab Platinum card and requires an eligible Schwab account. The inherited Amex ep-ADAP application URL is retained as a historical reference, not a readable current offer. Purchase APR is corrected from the readable product page; other financial fields and last_verified remain the July 2026 snapshot, not a complete current verification. Current product-specific disclosures are still needed to reverify those terms. The separate linked InvestorCard.jpg returned an HTML authorization error rather than image bytes and could not be used. Artwork-only verification on 2026-10-20: the American Express car-rental insurance directory labels this exact co-brand and links the 240x152 issuer-hosted image used here. This low-resolution benefit-directory artwork does not establish current design availability, application status or a full financial-terms refresh.
